styles.name: Golden Hour - Joel Meyerowitz Cape Light

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Golden-hour photographic light in the manner of Joel Meyerowitz's Cape Light: the sun within ten degrees of the horizon, long warm raking beams, and air that glows amber.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Honey, amber and apricot highlights against cool lavender shadows; warm white balance kept, skin glowing.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Low, directional sun from behind or the side; long stretched shadows, rim light on hair and edges, gentle flare when the sun is in frame.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Dust, pollen, spray or mist catching the light; surfaces turned gold where the beam lands.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Nostalgic and warm, with long shadows stretching the moment before it fades.

styles.name: Kodak Portra 400 - Alec Soth River Portraits

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Kodak Portra 400 color negative in the manner of Alec Soth's color portraits along the Mississippi: a forgiving portrait stock rated at 400 and usually overexposed by a stop, giving creamy low-contrast color and flattering skin.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Peach and apricot skin, warm neutral whites, pastel highlights that roll off instead of clipping, soft sage greens and muted blues; shadows lifted and slightly warm.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Wide latitude: bright skies and faces both hold detail; shadows open rather than crushed, highlight shoulder gentle.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Fine, even, tight grain visible in flat midtones and skies; no digital smoothing on skin.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Tender and unhurried, warmth and softness keeping every edge gentle.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Classic black-and-white street photography in the manner of Henri Cartier-Bresson's decisive moment: a 28–35 mm rangefinder at zone focus, catching the decisive instant when gesture and geometry line up.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: High-contrast monochrome, deep blacks and bright paper whites, few muted greys.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Hard available sun or overcast; shadows used as black shapes in the composition.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Honest grain, real wear on clothes and walls, slight motion blur in feet or hands.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Alert and fleeting, a small coincidence frozen before it dissolves back into the street.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Studio product photography in the manner of Paul Outerbridge's commercial still lifes: one object isolated on a light grey sweep, lit with large softboxes to show its form, material and edges precisely.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Accurate neutral color, clean light grey background, true material colors.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Large overhead softbox plus two strip lights for edge definition; soft contact shadow under the object.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Surface finish shown truthfully — brushed, polished, grained or stitched — without dust or scratches.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Precise and desirable, an object presented with calm, clinical respect.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Film noir in the manner of John Alton's hard-light noir photography: 1940s black-and-white crime cinema built from one hard key light, slatted shadows and oppressive darkness.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Monochrome with deep charcoal blacks, silver highlights and very few midtones.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Hard low-angle key through blinds, banisters or window frames throwing striped shadows; faces half lost in black.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Fine silver grain, cigarette smoke or fog catching the key light, glossy dark surfaces.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Fatalistic and tense, danger hiding in every band of shadow.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Symmetrical storybook cinema in the manner of Wes Anderson's centered storybook frames: meticulously centered compositions, pastel dollhouse sets and deadpan performers, as if every frame were a page of a picture book.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Curated pastel palette — pink, mustard, mint, powder blue — with one strong accent.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Soft frontal light, very few shadows, clean and flat like a lit diorama.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Handmade miniatures, uniforms, patterned wallpaper and precise props.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Whimsical and melancholic, deadpan charm inside strict order.

styles.name: 80s Sci-Fi - Ridley Scott Smoke and Backlight

dna.label: Look
dna.text: 80s practical sci-fi cinema in the manner of Ridley Scott's smoke-filled early 1980s science fiction: smoke-filled sets, backlit haze and glowing practical lights, shot on 35 mm anamorphic with streaking lens flares.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Deep blue-black with electric magenta, cyan and sodium-orange practicals; skin in mixed colored light.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Strong backlight through smoke, spinning fans and searchlights casting moving shafts, faces lit by small practicals.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Dense haze, steam, grimy industrial surfaces, cables and practical model detail.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Brooding and dystopian, a heavy night that never seems to end.

styles.name: Painterly Nature Anime Feature - Kazuo Oga Backgrounds

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Painterly nature anime feature in the manner of Kazuo Oga's painted forest backgrounds: simple cel characters set inside richly hand-painted, breathing landscapes of grass, cloud and forest.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Fresh greens, high summer blues, warm dappled golds; cels in soft flat color over dense watercolor-gouache backgrounds.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Dappled sunlight through leaves, towering bright cumulus, soft two-tone cel shadow.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Visible brush texture in grass, bark and cloud; delicate pencil lines on characters.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Gentle and wondrous, everyday magic breathing in the wind.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Moody miniature stop-motion in the manner of Henry Selick's stop-motion features: handcrafted puppets with replacement faces animated frame by frame in dark, detailed miniature sets.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Muted teal, plum and ochre with warm practical lights; deep shadows.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Tiny practical lamps and hard studio spots at miniature scale, crisp shadows, pools of warm light.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Fingerprints in clay, knitted and felted costumes, carved wood, visible seams on faces.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Eerie and tender, handmade dread with a beating heart.

styles.name: Snowbound Motel Hum - Stephen Shore Motels

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Snowbound motel hum in the manner of Stephen Shore's American motel rooms under snow: a roadside motel buried in snow, humming ice machines, blinking vacancy tubes and long exterior walkways where every door looks the same.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Blue-white snow, sickly yellow door lamps and a single red tube light glowing in the storm.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Weak door lamps and snowglare, long shadows along the walkway and dark room windows.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Piled snow, frosted glass, peeling motel doors, humming machines and icy railings.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Isolated, cold and hypnotic, the storm will not end.

styles.name: Fire-Lookout Tower Vigil - Jack Kerouac Desolation Peak

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Fire-lookout tower vigil in the manner of Desolation Peak fire lookouts: a lone watcher in a glass cabin atop a tower above endless forest, painted in warm gouache with smoke columns on the horizon.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Deep forest greens, amber sunset, violet smoke and warm cabin light.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Golden low sun, long tree shadows and a smoky glow on the horizon.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Weathered timber, cabin glass, pine needles and soft smoke plumes.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Watchful, peaceful and uneasy, beauty with danger far away.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Dario Argento Suspiria (1977) look: dye-transfer Technicolor saturation, rooms flooded with pure red, blue and green gel light, art nouveau stained glass and operatic baroque terror.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Pure saturated red, cobalt blue and emerald green gel light with deep black.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Hard colored gel lighting that paints whole rooms a single primary color.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Dye-transfer Technicolor print richness, fine grain and glossy blacks.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood with operatic nightmarish terror.

styles.name: Picnic at Hanging Rock 1975 - Hazy Pastoral Unease

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Peter Weir Picnic at Hanging Rock (1975) look: dreamy gauzy haze, Edwardian white dresses, sunlit Australian bush, ancient rock formations and uncanny stillness.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Hazy gold, white lace and eucalyptus green, true to the Picnic at Hanging Rock 1975 palette.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Soft diffused sunlight through gauze, lit the way Picnic at Hanging Rock 1975 lights its scenes.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Soft gauzy filtration and fine film grain, with the surface finish of Picnic at Hanging Rock 1975.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood with dreamy uncanny stillness.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Premium studio headshot photography in the manner of Peter Hurley's clean-background headshots: one large softbox key, controlled fill, and a seamless backdrop that isolates the sitter with precise, trustworthy polish.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Neutral mid-grey or charcoal seamless, accurate skin tones, restrained saturation, and a gentle vignette from backdrop falloff.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Large soft key at 30–45 degrees above eye level, fill 1–1.5 stops under, a thin hair light separating the head from the backdrop, and twin clean catchlights.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Real skin pores and fine hair left intact, light blemish cleanup only, fabric weave crisp at the collar.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Confident, calm, credible, and quietly approachable.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Classic studio oil painting in the manner of Johannes Vermeer's glazed oils: transparent warm darks laid in thin, opaque lead-white lights built up thick, and form turned by a strong single light in the academic chiaroscuro manner.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Earth palette of raw umber, burnt sienna, yellow ochre and vermilion with lead white; deep warm shadows, one cool accent, values grouped into a clear light mass and dark mass.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: One high side light at roughly a four-to-one ratio; the shadow side dissolves into the dark ground while lit planes turn through soft half-tones to small thick highlights.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Linen canvas weave visible in thin darks, raised bristle-brush impasto only in the brightest lights, a faint amber varnish film over the whole surface.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Grave and weighty, a quiet drama carried by the fall of light.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Soft transparent watercolor in the manner of John Singer Sargent's watercolors: diluted pigment flooded wet-in-wet onto damp cold-press paper, with the white of the paper serving as the only white.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Pale transparent washes that granulate and mix on the paper; soft blues, sap greens and rose, values rarely darker than a mid-tone.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Highlights are reserved untouched paper; shadows are a second glaze laid over a dry first wash, never opaque paint.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Cold-press paper tooth, granulating pigment in the valleys, cauliflower blooms where wet met damp, hard tide lines at the edges of dried pools.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Gentle and airy, a scene breathing through damp light.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Impressionist oil sketch in the manner of Claude Monet's broken-color oils: short separate strokes of unmixed color laid side by side outdoors, catching one moment of changing daylight rather than fixed forms.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Broken color with no black, shadows made of violet and blue, lights of cream, lemon and pink; complementary strokes vibrate against each other.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Strong natural daylight at a specific hour; colored shadows and reflected light matter more than modeled volume.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Short thick dabs and commas of paint on a light ground, visible bristle tracks, ground peeking through between strokes.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Light, fresh and fleeting, a breath of air caught quickly.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: East Asian ink wash in the manner of Sesshu Toyo's ink landscapes: a single loaded brush of carbon ink on absorbent paper, one stroke per form, with pressure and water content doing all the modeling.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Black ink diluted into five tones from dense black to palest grey, large areas of untouched paper, at most one small touch of red or ochre.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: No cast light; volume and distance come from ink density, with dark near forms and pale dissolving far forms.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Absorbent rice paper with feathered bleeding at stroke edges, dry-brush flying white where the brush ran out, splashed ink in the darks.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Quiet and spare, energy concentrated in a few decisive strokes.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Expressive charcoal drawing in the manner of Kathe Kollwitz's charcoal: willow vine charcoal swept in broad gestures, pushed into velvety blacks with compressed charcoal and wiped or erased back to light.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Deep matte velvet black with no sheen, smoky greys rubbed with the side of the hand, bright lights pulled out with a kneaded eraser.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Big dramatic light and shadow masses; shadows fused into one dark shape, light carved out subtractively.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Rough laid paper with charcoal dust caught in the ridges, finger smudges, broken dragged strokes and fallen black powder.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Raw and physical, energy caught in fast sweeping gestures.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Polished digital painting in the manner of Loish's digital painting: a painted illustration built on layers with hard round and textured brushes, finished with a sharp focal area and softer, economical surroundings.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Rich RGB color organized in a clear value plan, warm key against cool shadow, saturated accents kept to the focal area.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Motivated key light with painted bounce light and rim light; shadows grouped into large simple shapes, glow layers used sparingly.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Visible brush strokes and subtle canvas-texture brushes in the background, tighter blended rendering on faces and hero materials.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Cinematic, vivid and clear, a finished story illustration.

styles.name: Pixel Art (16-bit) - Sixteen-Bit Console Pixel Art

dna.label: Look
dna.text: 16-bit pixel art in the manner of 1990s 16-bit console pixel art: a scene drawn pixel by pixel on a low-resolution grid with a limited palette, hand-placed anti-aliasing and dithered transitions.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Restricted palette of about 32 to 64 colors, hue-shifted ramps from cool shadows to warm highlights, no gradients beyond ramps and dither.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Clear top-left light with two or three shading steps per material; checkerboard dither for soft transitions.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Crisp square pixels on a visible grid, clean one-pixel outlines, no blurred scaling, no sub-pixel smoothing.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Nostalgic, crafted and adventurous, a console-era world.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Flat vector illustration in the manner of flat vector illustration after Charley Harper: clean Bezier shapes filled with solid colors, built from simple geometric primitives with perfectly smooth curves.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Limited flat palette of five to eight colors, harmonious and saturated, with shadow shapes as darker flat tints.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Flat shading only: one hard-edged shadow shape and one highlight shape per form, no gradients.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: No texture at all; pure flat fills, crisp mathematically smooth edges, consistent corner radii.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Clean, friendly and orderly, a modern editorial clarity.

styles.name: Kinuko Y. Craft - Jeweled Fairy-Tale Oil

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Kinuko Y. Craft fairy-tale painting: oil and watercolor built like a medieval miniature, every jewel, embroidery thread, leaf and flower rendered with obsessive detail, ornate borders and a rich, precious palette.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Deep ruby, lapis blue, moss green and burnished gold, rich and precious.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Even, jewel-like light with no harsh shadows, like an illuminated manuscript.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Fine oil glazes over watercolor, tiny detailed brushwork on every surface.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood with enchanted precious fairy-tale wonder.

styles.name: Eyvind Earle - Flat Stylized Gouache Forest

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Eyvind Earle painting and Sleeping Beauty backgrounds: flat stylized gouache with tall vertical trees, geometric layered hills, precise decorative detail and a jewel-toned, medieval-tapestry sense of order.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Jewel-toned teal, deep green, rose and gold in flat, precise shapes.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Stylized light: flat bands of color and tiny precise highlights, no soft shading.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Flat opaque gouache with crisp edges and fine decorative detail.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood with still, enchanted stateliness.

styles.name: Vincent van Gogh - Loaded Brush Impasto

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Vincent van Gogh oil painting: thick loaded brush strokes in swirling directional rhythms, pure intense color side by side, visible ridges of paint and vibrating energy.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Intense cobalt, chrome yellow, emerald and orange, true to the Vincent van Gogh palette.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Vibrating light made of pure color strokes, lit the way Vincent van Gogh lights its scenes.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Thick impasto ridges and loaded brush strokes, with the surface finish of Vincent van Gogh.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood with vibrating emotional intensity.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Henri Matisse late cut-outs: shapes cut freely with scissors from paper painted in gouache, organic leaves, stars and figures pinned on white, with visible brush strokes in the color and slightly lifted edges.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Gouache ultramarine, coral, lemon yellow, emerald and black on white.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Soft daylight with tiny shadows under lifted paper edges.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Brush-streaked gouache paper, scissor-cut edges and pinholes, with the surface finish of Henri Matisse.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood with joyful free rhythm.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Joseph Cornell shadow boxes shrunk into an open matchbox: a surreal assemblage of found things, a cut-out bird, a glass marble, a star chart scrap and a cork ball on a wire, arranged in a worn compartment like a poetic memory box.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Faded Prussian blue, aged cream paper, weathered white paint and tarnished brass.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Soft museum light falling into the box with gentle shadows in the corners.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Worn wood, peeling white paint, yellowed paper cut-outs, glass marbles and rusty wire.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood with wistful dreamlike nostalgia.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Flung-ink splash in the manner of Ralph Steadman's flung ink: ink thrown and splashed onto paper in bold bursts, then given just enough brush marks to become mountains, trees or creatures.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Black ink in every dilution from dense to watery grey on white paper, with at most one small color accent.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Light comes from the white paper left between splashes; darkness comes from where the ink landed heaviest.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Radiating spatter, droplet trails, pooled splash centers and a few sharp brush accents on absorbent paper.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Explosive, spontaneous and poetic, a landscape born from an accident.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Cross-contour belts in the manner of Moebius' cross-contour hatching: every form described by parallel ink lines that wrap around its surface like belts or topographic rings, showing volume without shading.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Black fineliner on white paper, occasionally one colored line set for a single important form.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Tone comes from line spacing: belts crowd together on turning edges and open up on broad lit planes.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Clean even fineliner lines, slight tremor, and precise bends where belts cross ridges and hollows.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Analytical, calm and hypnotic, like watching a shape being measured.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Stencil-print illustration using two flat ink layers and deliberate overlap shapes, in the manner of Shepard Fairey's two-color stencils.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Use two inks from the requested palette and their overlap. Separate adjacent forms through value, negative space and controlled overprinting.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Express light through a small number of flat value regions. Avoid smooth airbrushed shading.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Keep ink coverage mostly even, with a restrained texture at broad fill boundaries. Let overlap structure carry depth.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Follow the requested mood through mass, contrast and overlap density. The print medium does not dictate the subject or theme.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Engraved illustration describing form with ordered families of fine incised lines, in the manner of Gustave Dore's engraved tone.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Use a restrained ink-ground relationship while respecting user color requirements. Build intermediate values through line density.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Align hatching with the form and use secondary cross-lines only in deeper shadows. Keep highlighted planes comparatively open.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Maintain crisp incised marks with small pressure variations. Distinguish line density from random scratches or a uniform grid.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Carry the requested mood through line spacing and contrast. Do not impose historical objects or scientific context.

styles.name: Stacked Paper - Hari and Deepti Paper Light Boxes

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Cut-paper illustration made from a small hierarchy of flat colored shapes with visible layered depth, in the manner of Hari and Deepti's layered paper light boxes.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Use broad paper-color regions chosen from the requested palette. Limit small accents and maintain clear neighboring values.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Use shallow consistent contact shadows between paper layers to reveal overlap. These support shadows do not replace lighting requested within the represented scene.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Keep edges mostly clean with slight hand-cut variation. Show paper thickness sparingly at overlaps, not around every internal detail.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood; paper construction does not require a cute, childlike or cheerful subject.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Opaque painted illustration organized into broad color planes with selective visible brush edges, in the manner of Milton Avery's flat color planes.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Build a compact palette from the requested colors. Separate light, middle and dark planes clearly without outlining every boundary.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Represent illumination as connected changes of plane and value. Reserve soft transitions for selected turning surfaces.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Use matte paint coverage with occasional dry drag at a few edges. Keep the bulk of each plane calm and opaque.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Retain the requested mood through chroma, value spacing and edge softness instead of substituting a storybook scene.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Classic watercolor storybook in the manner of Beatrix Potter's watercolors: light pencil underdrawing tinted with transparent washes, small animals and cottages observed with naturalist care.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Botanical pastels, sage, fawn and soft blue, warm neutrals, white paper left for highlights.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Soft diffuse daylight, pale cool shadow washes, paper white as the brightest light.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Cold-press paper grain, feathered wash edges fading into white vignettes, fine pencil detail on fur.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Tender, pastoral and comforting, a quiet afternoon in the hedgerow.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Franco-Belgian clear line: one uniform ink contour around every form, flat unshaded color and meticulously drawn backgrounds equal in clarity to the figures.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Flat bright album colors, clear sky blues, brick reds and ochres, local color with no modeling.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Even daylight without hatching; at most a single flat darker tone for cast shadows under objects.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Smooth printed album paper, clean color fills, no brush texture, no hatching, no screentone.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Lucid, curious adventure told with calm intelligence and gentle irony.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Art Deco poster: streamlined geometric forms, radiating sunbursts and speed lines, smooth airbrushed gradients and gold-on-black glamour.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Black, deep teal, ivory and metallic-looking gold, gradients banded in smooth airbrush steps.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Radial sunburst light behind the subject, stylized gradient bands, crisp rim highlights on curves.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Smooth lithographic ink, airbrushed transitions, polished chrome and lacquer suggested graphically.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Luxurious, confident and machine-age optimistic, a gilded evening in motion.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Film matte painting in the manner of Dylan Cole's film matte paintings: a photoreal digital painting made to extend a live-action plate, with invisible seams between painted architecture, photo texture and sky.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Filmic grade with strong atmospheric perspective: distant planes lifted toward the sky color and desaturated, the foreground holding the deepest blacks.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: One sun or moon direction shared by every element, soft haze scatter, and cast shadows matched in hardness and temperature across all layers.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Photographic-scale surface detail near camera, simplified painted detail with distance, crisp rooflines and ridge silhouettes, fine aerial haze.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Vast, still and believable, a place that seems to have always existed.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Japanese ukiyo-e color woodblock print: key-block outlines in sumi ink, flat colors from separate blocks and bokashi gradients wiped onto the block.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Prussian blue, indigo, soft vermilion, ochre and pale pink on mellow cream paper, with bokashi gradients in skies and water.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: No cast shadows; form carried by outline and flat color, time of day told by the gradient sky.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Visible wood grain in flat areas, crisp carved key lines, slight registration shifts and baren-rubbed pigment mottling.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Calm, rhythmic and seasonal, a moment of passing weather.

styles.name: Gothic Jewel - Master of Mary of Burgundy

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Fine contours, small luminous pigment areas and selective opaque highlights give existing forms a precise illuminated-miniature finish on a light ground, in the manner of the Master of Mary of Burgundy.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Use a light, restrained ground and small vivid areas drawn from the requested palette. Do not make gold or another metallic color mandatory.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Place small opaque highlights on already lit planes and keep shadow shapes compact. Respect the requested light direction without adding a source or halo effect.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Combine fine drawn contours with flat, controlled pigment accents. Keep surface texture subtle and distinct from the material of the depicted subject.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Let the contrast between clean masses and precise highlights carry a quiet sense of refinement. Preserve the requested mood without implying a religious scene or historical setting.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Elegant silhouettes, delicate contours, decorative planes and small, controlled highlights create an ornamental illustration treatment, in the manner of Kay Nielsen's fairytale plates. dna.text: An authored sepia-lithograph and matte-gouache adventure illustration using Victorian mechanical design vocabulary: working gear trains, articulated housings and warm bronze/brass against soot-dark iron, in the manner of Albert Robida's 1880s future-city lithographs. Use pressure routes and steam valves only where the requested subject already supports them; no period setting is required.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Use brass, bronze and patinated copper against iron, soot and aged ivory, with a restrained enamel accent. Preserve explicit palettes and clear focal, support and shadow values.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Honor specified light direction and sources. When unspecified, use warm metal highlights against cool soot shadows; invent no glowing source and let no steam obscure the subject.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Distinguish brass, bronze, copper, cast iron, enamel, leather and paper through tactile planes and controlled wear. Translate open material choices into a mechanical finish.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Convey ingenious, hand-built pressure and craft while following the requested emotion. Period ornament informs design, not a mandatory historical story.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: A high-tech, street-adapted language of asymmetric modular design, embedded interfaces, hacked circuitry and selective emissive color, with polished synthetic surfaces against worn everyday materials, in the manner of Katsuhiro Otomo's Neo-Tokyo.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Use dark neutrals with sharp cyan, magenta, violet or acid-green signals and warm counterpoints. Respect locked colors; treat neon as placed information, not a wash.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Honor explicit lighting and time. Where unspecified, allow motivated emissive seams and tight bloom on integrated sources with crisp colored reflections; do not force rain, night or signs.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Contrast coated metal, polymer, glass, rubber, fabric and worn analogue surfaces. Restyle open materials as synthetic or hand-modified without turning everything to wet chrome.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Suggest tension, intimacy, speed or mutual aid through advanced technology meeting everyday wear. Follow requested mood; dystopia and corporate oppression are optional.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Satpunk in the manner of Simon Stalenhag's rural machines and dishes: a world obsessed with satellites, of rooftop dishes, orbital junk, uplink shrines and people tracking lights across the sky.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Night sky indigo with white satellite streaks, dish silver and warm window lights.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Starlight, satellite glints and warm light from rooftop shacks.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Weathered satellite dishes, cable bundles, solar panels and scrap antenna forests.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Yearning and connected, people listening to the sky for voices from orbit.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Build a tactile late-analog design language from chunky rounded rectangles, cassette-window shapes, paired reels, slider rows, and cable loops, with the geometry applied selectively to forms rather than requiring a cassette as the subject, in the manner of the chunky computer consoles of the 1979 film Alien.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Favor warm cream, amber, graphite, and restrained teal or blue-green indicators; keep the large masses warm and quiet, with small colored signals providing contrast.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Use broad panel highlights, soft amber lamp glow, and dark window recesses to reveal molded depth; keep reflections graphic and localized instead of glossy product photography.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Contrast matte molded plastic, brushed metal edges, translucent smoked inserts, and visible tape-like ribbons; use wear at corners and controls, not a blanket vintage filter.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Suggest an intimate, repairable analog future: practical, lived-in, and quietly optimistic, with the source subject's own emotional tone intact.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Mid-century modern interior: low horizontal lines, walnut and teak casework on tapered splayed legs, molded plywood curves, open plan with a floating room divider.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Walnut brown, teak amber, warm off-white, with mustard, olive, burnt orange or teal accents in tweed and enamel; medium contrast, warm overall.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Low-sun daylight through clerestory or floor-to-ceiling glazing, cone and globe pendants, warm pools of light across low furniture.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Book-matched walnut veneer, oiled teak, nubby wool tweed, terrazzo or cork floors, slatted wood screens and ribbed glass.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Optimistic, warm and relaxed, a confident post-war modernity.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Art Deco architecture in the manner of William Van Alen's Chrysler Building: stepped setback massing, strong vertical piers, and ornament concentrated in spandrels, crowns and entrances as chevrons, zigzags, sunbursts and stylised relief.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Cream limestone or glazed terracotta with black granite base, polished nickel, brass and gold, emerald or jade accents; high contrast at entrances.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Floodlighting from below at night grazing vertical piers, or crisp daylight picking out relief; stepped crowns lit against a dark sky.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Glazed terracotta and faience cladding, polished black granite, cast aluminium or nickel spandrel panels, etched glass, geometric terrazzo at entries.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Glamorous, optimistic and streamlined power reaching upward.

styles.name: Verdant Elven Sanctuary - Alan Lee Elven Halls

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Grown sanctuary architecture in the manner of Alan Lee's elven architecture drawings: living beech and ash trunks trained into tall lancet arches, pale limestone shells grafted between them, and branch forks forming the window tracery.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Bone-white limestone, silver-grey bark, fern and moss greens, thin silver inlay lines; low saturation in a high, airy value key.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Soft canopy-filtered daylight with green bounce and no hard sun; the branch tracery throws lace-like shadow patterns across the pale stone.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Bark grain fusing seamlessly into chiselled limestone, lichen at the footings, silver wire inlay tracing every joint, leaves growing through the tracery.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Hushed, ancient and gentle, a building that was grown over centuries rather than laid.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Hobby scenic layout in the manner of Hamburg's Miniatur Wunderland layouts: the subject set on a baseboard landscape of static-grass flock, lichen and clump-foliage trees, plaster rock castings and a painted sky backdrop.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Slightly too-uniform flock greens, dry-brushed grey rock, ochre paths and a soft painted blue backdrop.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Even overhead layout lighting with soft shadows; faint seam where the backdrop meets the scenery.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Upright static-grass fibres, sponge-like foliage clumps, dry-brushed plaster rock, gloss resin water.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Quiet, loving and orderly, a landscape built on evenings and weekends.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Haute couture in the manner of Cristobal Balenciaga's sculptural couture: one sculptural, hand-built garment treated as wearable architecture, where volume, cut and handwork are the spectacle.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Restrained palette of one or two deep couture colors (oxblood, ink, ivory, gold) against neutral surroundings.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Hard editorial key with sculpted shadow that describes every fold and cavity of the garment.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Silk duchesse, gazar, organza, hand-beading, feathers and visible couture stitching at hems and seams.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Rare, ceremonial, theatrical and imperious, carried by the wearer's posture, styling and attitude.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: 1950s domestic-pop fashion in the manner of Christian Dior's 1947 New Look: fitted bodices, full circle skirts over petticoats, cardigans, pearls, gloves and neat set hair, or boxy suits with fedoras.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Technicolor pastels — mint, cherry, butter yellow, powder blue — with crisp white.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Bright, even, cheerful light like a vintage advertisement, shaped to reveal garment cut, drape, texture and fit on the wearer.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Cotton poplin, taffeta petticoats, wool twinsets, pearls and patent leather.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Optimistic, polished, wholesome and slightly uncanny, carried by the wearer's posture, styling and attitude.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Airy fantasy formalwear built from translucent layers, fine silvered embroidery and long fluid lines; its identity comes from delicate fabric construction, not a new character type, in the manner of Tim Walker's fairytale fashion photographs.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Favor luminous, pale value relationships with soft silver or pearl accents, while honoring requested hues and maintaining natural skin and facial detail.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Use broad, gentle light and fine edge transmission to reveal translucent cloth. Match the prompt's lighting and setting; do not create a supernatural glow source or scene.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Use chiffon, organza, fine gauze, satin and delicate metallic thread. Keep each sheer layer distinct from skin and neighboring fabric, with light embroidery rather than hard armor.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Create a quiet, weightless impression through soft layers and restrained ornament, without declaring the wearer angelic, royal or magical.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Dieter Rams products for Braun: calm rectilinear bodies in white, grey and aluminum, a strict grid of round buttons or slots, one small green or orange accent, and nothing that is not needed.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: White, light grey, aluminum and one green or orange accent.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Soft even studio light, done exactly the way Dieter Rams does it.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Matte plastic, perforated aluminum and fine seams, done exactly the way Dieter Rams does it.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood with honest quiet order.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Susan Kare icons for the 1984 Macintosh: one-bit black pixels on white in a 32 pixel grid, witty tiny drawings where every single pixel matters, shown enlarged with crisp square edges.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Pure black pixels on white, done exactly the way Susan Kare does it.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Flat pixels with no shading, done exactly the way Susan Kare does it.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Crisp enlarged square pixels, done exactly the way Susan Kare does it.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood with witty tiny-screen charm.

styles.name: Leonetto Cappiello - One Figure on Black

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Leonetto Cappiello posters: one flamboyant colorful figure (a jester, a green devil, a dancing horse) bursting out of a solid black background, with the brand name in bold letters, pure vivid color and energy.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Vivid orange, green, red and yellow against pure black.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Flat vivid color with minimal modeling, done exactly the way Leonetto Cappiello does it.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Lithographic print on poster paper, done exactly the way Leonetto Cappiello does it.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood with exuberant Belle Epoque energy.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Maija Isola Marimekko prints: giant, bold, simplified shapes such as poppies, stones or waves drawn with a free hand, huge scale on the fabric, flat saturated color on white, and joyful graphic confidence.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Flat saturated red, black, orange or blue on white cotton.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Flat printed fabric in soft daylight, done exactly the way Maija Isola does it.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Screen-printed cotton with slight ink edge, done exactly the way Maija Isola does it.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood with bold Nordic joy.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Fire and magma as in the volcano photographs of Katia and Maurice Krafft: flame and molten rock contained on the target, incandescent orange cracks under a black cooling crust, dripping lava and short licking flames.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Incandescent orange and yellow in cracks, deep red edges and matte black basalt crust.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Self-illuminating lava glow casting hot orange light up onto the target.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Pahoehoe ropy crust, cracked basalt, dripping lava and floating embers.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Fierce, dangerous, primal and scorching hot, coming from the effect rather than added scenery.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Petal storm as in hanafubuki, the cherry blossom snowstorms of Japanese spring, and the falling petals of Ukiyo-e prints: a swirl of flower petals spiraling around the target.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Pale pink sakura, white or crimson petals, concentrated around the target while the rest of the scene keeps its palette.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Soft spring backlight glowing through petals, so the effect lights the target and casts believable local light.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Floating petals caught at different angles in motion, with physically plausible motion, density and falloff.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Romantic, graceful, fleeting and poetic, coming from the effect rather than added scenery.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Raw concrete in the manner of Tadao Ando's smooth tie-holed concrete: board-formed or cast concrete with tie holes, air voids and grey mineral texture.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Cool grey concrete with darker water stains, kept on the material while the rest of the scene keeps its own palette.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Flat overcast light that reads texture, chosen to reveal how the material reflects, absorbs or transmits light.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Cast concrete with board marks, tie holes and pits.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Brutal, heavy, austere and monumental, carried by the material itself rather than by added props.
